heard: For 800 years, foreign armies failed to breach Rome. Emperor Honorius ruled safely from the distant city of Ravenna. Outside the walls, King Alaric tightened a starving blockade. On August 24, the Visigoths poured through the Salarian Gate. For three days, the conquerors pillaged the ancient capital. Saint Jerome wrote that the world itself was taken. Foreign German armies had finally breached Rome after 800 years.
